seo.metaTitle: ADA & WCAG PDF accessibility checker — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Check document structure against US ADA Title II/III, Section 508, and PDF/UA (ISO 14289) accessibility rules: document title, language tag, heading nesting, and image alt attributes. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/pdf/ada-check-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: ADA & WCAG PDF accessibility checker processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/pdf/ada-check-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does ADA & WCAG PDF accessibility checker upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. ADA & WCAG PDF accessibility checker executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/ada-check-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does ADA & WCAG PDF accessibility checker upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. ADA & WCAG PDF accessibility checker executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/ada-check-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate ADA & WCAG PDF accessibility checker?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/ada_pdf.json or open /tools/ada-pdf?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
